## What REST cannot see here

- **The theme file tree** — `functions.php`, `style.css`, the template hierarchy, block
  patterns, and enqueued assets are all on disk, not in REST. Only the theme's name,
  version, and status (admin-only) appear here.
- **Plugin settings** — the configuration each plugin stores in `wp_options` is not
  REST-readable. We see that a plugin is active, not how it is configured.
- **Must-use (`mu-plugins`) and dropins** — not reported by `GET /wp/v2/plugins`.
- **Deactivated code paths** — inactive plugins appear in the inventory (admin only) but
  their behavior, hooks, and any leftover data are not introspectable over REST.
- Without admin, the **entire plugin/theme inventory** is "not visible at this role" —
  the only signal left is the REST namespace list in `01-site.md`.
